opening.argument: The tutorial shows a straightforward rewards exchange: viewers download free listed apps, open them for 30 seconds, receive credits, and turn those credits in for prizes, including gift cards. The sharing link offers a bonus, while the profile installation is described as a way for FreeMyApps to track app downloads; referrals are presented as optional. Those steps make the reward conditional on participation, but the record does not show a false delivered outcome, a charge, a password request, confirmed data misuse, or another deceptive mechanism. On the evidence presented, this is an ordinary app-rewards promotion, not a demonstrated scheme to take money or credentials.
